bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 100-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 100 日均线上方

read.en: Nvidia rose 1.4% on Oct 19 to $217.09, trading between $214.70 and $219.62. It is below its falling 5-day ($219.7), 30-day ($224.8) and 10-day ($226.1) averages and back above the rising 100-day ($214.5) and the rising 200-day ($203.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, its histogram steady, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($238.63), and RSI is 41.5.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月19日上涨 1.4%，收于 $217.09，盘中区间 $214.70–219.62。股价位于下行的 5 日（$219.7）、30 日（$224.8）和 10 日均线（$226.1）下方，重回上行的 100 日均线（$214.5）上方，并位于上行的 200 日均线（$203.1）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图持平，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$238.63），RSI 为 41.5。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 100-day average lost on Oct 16, and the day's low held above it. Resistance is $219.6–219.7 (Oct 19 high, Oct 14 low, 5-day average), then $224.8–226.1 (30 and 10-day averages) and $238.6 (SAR). Support is $214.5–214.7 (100-day, Oct 19 low), then $212.9 (Oct 15 low) and $207–209 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows). A close above $219.7 would open $224.8–226.1.
